_comment: Config for Module A04 (Storyboard). Splits a concept's satisfying_beats into fixed-length scenes, one Veo clip each. Hard duration cap enforced in the workflow: scenes * clip_seconds must be <= max_total_seconds (60). Each scene names which library assets are present and HOW they are positioned this scene (same assets, new position = the 'change position, don't regenerate' rule).
